title: ChatGPT Free Version Epic Upgrade: GPT-5.6 Luna Unlimited Usage Plus/Pro Users Also Have Exclusive Benefits

content_html:
OpenAI has released a major update for ChatGPT today. Free users now have the default model switched to GPT-5.6Luna, and the Chat mode no longer has text conversation limits, allowing unlimited usage. This feature will be rolled out to all free users this week.

Plus and Pro users also received upgrades. The GPT-5.6Sol in Chat has undergone specialized optimization, and the official stated that it shows significant improvements in factual accuracy and answer quality. Altman posted on X platform: "5.6Sol performs much better in chats, and free users can also have unlimited text chats!"

OpenAI stated that 1 billion people per week use ChatGPT for quick Q&A, web search, planning, research, consulting, and complex decision-making. This GPT-5.6Sol update is designed to cover the entire range of these usages. The updated model provides more focused responses, adjusting the level of detail based on the question, avoiding unnecessary formatting, and offering helpful corrections when simply agreeing without value. For Plus and Pro users, the same model powers both instant answers and deep reasoning, providing a more consistent experience.

In particular, for quick questions, the model provides direct answers with necessary context; for complex tasks such as multi-step planning, research, or writing, it gives more complete responses while keeping the core recommendations clear. In the comparison examples shown by OpenAI, GPT-5.5Instant lists all information like rain, wind, and temperature in a cycling consultation scenario, while GPT-5.6Sol first answers the user's real concern, identifies wind as the main influencing factor instead of rain, keeps only the details needed by the cyclist, and even directly generates a weather forecast sheet.

There are also significant improvements in hallucinations. Internal assessments by OpenAI show that the proportion of at least one factual error in financial, medical, and legal prompts decreased by about 62% for GPT-5.6Luna compared to GPT-5.5Instant, and by about 68% for GPT-5.6Sol.

Subscribers also received UI experience updates. After the release of the three 5.6 models, users had to select the model and inference strength simultaneously, which was complicated. Now, the Chat interface introduces the same slider feature used in Codex. Plus and Pro users can adjust the model's thinking volume on the web, mobile, and desktop versions—keep it in fast mode for daily questions, and increase the slider when planning, researching, writing, coding, or making decisions.

Free users now have full access to GPT-5.6Luna, with unlimited text chatting. However, features such as image generation and file uploads still have limits. Since Luna is not a universal model, OpenAI has added a new "Think" button to handle complex issues.

Notably, this GPT-5.6Sol update is limited to the ChatGPT chat experience, and the GPT-5.6Sol version used in Work and Codex is not included in this update.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 今天发布了 ChatGPT 的重大更新。 免费用户现在默认型号切换为GPT-5.6Luna，聊天模式不再有文字对话限制，可以无限制使用。 此功能将于本周向所有免费用户推出。

Plus 和 Pro 用户也获得了升级。 Chat 中的 GPT-5.6Sol 进行了专门的优化，官方表示在事实准确性和答案质量上都有显着提升。 Altman在X平台发帖：“5.6Sol在聊天方面表现好多了，免费用户还可以无限量文字聊天！”

OpenAI 表示，每周有 10 亿人使用 ChatGPT 进行快速问答、网络搜索、规划、研究、咨询和复杂决策。 此 GPT-5.6Sol 更新旨在涵盖这些用途的整个范围。 更新后的模型提供了更有针对性的答复，根据问题调整详细程度，避免不必要的格式，并在简单同意但没有价值的情况下提供有用的更正。 对于 Plus 和 Pro 用户，同一模型可以提供即时答案和深度推理，从而提供更一致的体验。

特别是，对于快速问题，该模型会提供带有必要上下文的直接答案；对于多步骤规划、研究或写作等复杂任务，它会给出更完整的响应，同时保持核心建议清晰。 在OpenAI展示的对比示例中，GPT-5.5Instant列出了骑行咨询场景中的所有雨、风、温度等信息，而GPT-5.6Sol首先回答了用户真正关心的问题，将风而不是雨确定为主要影响因素，只保留骑行者所需的细节，甚至直接生成天气预报表。

幻觉也有显着改善。 OpenAI 的内部评估显示，与 GPT-5.5Instant 相比，GPT-5.6Luna 的财务、医疗和法律提示中至少一项事实错误的比例下降了约 62%，GPT-5.6Sol 下降了约 68%。

订阅者还收到了 UI 体验更新。 三个5.6模型发布后，用户必须同时选择模型和推理强度，这很复杂。 现在，聊天界面引入了 Codex 中使用的相同滑块功能。 Plus 和 Pro 用户可以在网络、移动和桌面版本上调整模型的思考量 - 将其保持在快速模式以处理日常问题，并在计划、研究、写作、编码或做出决策时增加滑块。

免费用户现在可以完全访问 GPT-5.6Luna，并进行无限制的文本聊天。 然而，图像生成和文件上传等功能仍然存在限制。 由于Luna不是通用模型，OpenAI添加了一个新的“思考”按钮来处理复杂的问题。

值得注意的是，本次 GPT-5.6Sol 更新仅限于 ChatGPT 聊天体验，Work 和 Codex 中使用的 GPT-5.6Sol 版本不包含在本次更新中。
